personalInfo.summary: Distributed systems engineer with 10+ years architecting fault-tolerant microservices and high-throughput pipelines. Proven record cutting response latency, 98% P99 SLA adherence, and managing $40M+ annual cloud budgets.

bullets: Architected multi-region consensus protocol handling 450k+ transactions/sec with 99.999% availability & zero data loss during failovers.
Overhauled caching layer reducing P99 response latency, 98% improvement from 240ms to 4.8ms under peak load.
Managed $12M cloud infrastructure across AWS & GCP, cutting compute waste by 34% through automated spot-instance bin-packing.
Special characters verified: % & $ # _ { } < > " ' – — ’ and unicode (Café, Zürich, 日本語, €500).
Led migration of monolithic order service to event-driven serverless architecture, scaling throughput 4.2x.
Implemented end-to-end telemetry and distributed tracing across 80+ microservices using OpenTelemetry & Prometheus.

projects.name: ChronosEngine
projects.description: High-performance distributed time-series database engine written in Rust with SIMD-vectorized querying.
bullets: Engineered zero-copy parquet ingestion pipeline sustaining 1.2M metrics/sec per node.
Authored Raft replication layer guaranteeing linearizable reads and atomic partition failover.
